contact: 60 to 104 hundredths of a second between successive touchdown events of the same foot; ground-specific support >5 N, time-axis 5-frame median filter; mean within each environment and equal weight across environments. Signed travel is the integral of yaw-frame vx over each cycle. Slip is force-weighted horizontal surface contact point speed evaluated only on loaded feet (>5 N) using physics reward values.
foot_sweep: Local frame x of the left/right foot link origins. P95 minus P05 over time per foot and per environment; then average over feet and environments. Units metres.
reference: Expert cycle travel estimated from exported reference mean vx times its annotated stride period. No contact forces or per-frame world root speeds in 22D TXT.
windows: All stable policy histories, including 9 preceding states for t=200. All possible uniformly sampled post-windows from the exact selected cruise clip. Checkpoint normalizer and frozen discriminator, original command and reward formula. Unit style lies in [0,1]. Cross scoring keeps the velocity conditioning fixed and varies the expert clip.
